SELECT value AS dollars_per_hour FROM govblock_labor.bls_ce_data WHERE series_id = 'CES0500000003' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M12'
Which journals have the most articles in PubMed?
SELECT journal_title, count(*) AS articles FROM govblock_health.pubmed_articles GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the molecular formula of nicotine?
SELECT c1 AS formula FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mass WHERE c0 = '89594'
Which Puerto Rico municipalities have the most mapped buildings in the PR100 study?
SELECT addrcity, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_energy.oedi_pr100_setbacks_buildings WHERE addrcity IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Do electricians earn more in New York or Texas?
SELECT area_title, a_median, h_median FROM govblock_labor.oes_all_data_m_sheet_a WHERE occ_title = 'Electricians' AND area_title IN ('New York', 'Texas') AND naics_title = 'Cross-industry' LIMIT 10
Which utilities operate the most generators?
SELECT utility_name, count(DISTINCT plant_code || '-' || generator_id) AS generators FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did federal campaigns spend on travel in the 2016 cycle?
SELECT sum(transaction_amt) AS total FROM govblock_fec.operating_expenditures WHERE cast(cycle AS varchar) = '2016' AND category_desc LIKE 'Travel%'
What makes of vehicle were the drivers killed in 2022 crashes driving?
SELECT makename, count(*) AS drivers_killed FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_person WHERE per_typ = '1' AND inj_sev = '4' AND cast(death_yr AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many chemistry patents were published in the United States in 2020?
SELECT count(*) AS patents FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_patents WHERE country = 'US' AND publication_date LIKE '2020%'
Which states have the most hospitals enrolled in Medicare?
SELECT state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_hospital_enrollments WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many words long is a granted patent's typical independent claim?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(pat_wrd_avg AS double)), 1) AS avg_words FROM govblock_patents.claims_patent_document_stats
Which states logged the most site visits to water systems in 2024?
SELECT substr(pwsid, 1, 2) AS state, count(*) AS visits FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_site_visits WHERE substr(visit_date, 7, 4) = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many urologists are enrolled in Medicare?
SELECT count(DISTINCT npi) AS clinicians FROM govblock_health.cc_dac_nationaldownloadablefile WHERE pri_spec = 'UROLOGY'
Which political organizations reported the most itemised contributions?
SELECT column03 AS organization, sum(try_cast(column15 AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_nonprofits.pol_org_8872_contributions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

Which law schools have educated the most judges?

SELECT s.name, count(DISTINCT e.person_id) AS judges FROM govblock_courts.people_db_educations AS e JOIN govblock_courts.people_db_schools AS s ON s.id = e.school_id WHERE e.degree_level = 'jd' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many text sections have been extracted from government forms?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_reference.forms_text_parts
In which languages are PubMed articles written, apart from English?
SELECT languages, count(*) AS articles FROM govblock_health.pubmed_articles WHERE languages <> 'eng' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

Which states added the most wind capacity in 2021?
SELECT t_state, sum(try_cast(t_cap AS double)) / 1000 AS megawatts FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE cast(p_year AS varchar) = '2021' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the average Henry Hub spot price in 2023?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(value AS double)), 2) AS dollars_per_mmbtu FROM govblock_energy.eia_ng_data WHERE series_id = 'NG.RNGWHHD.D' AND period LIKE '2023%'
Which kinds of power plants have the most operating capacity on the national map?
SELECT type, sum(try_cast(oper_cap AS double)) AS capacity_mw FROM govblock_siting.hifld_power_plants WHERE status = 'OP' AND try_cast(oper_cap AS double) > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the combined capacity of all wind turbines in Kansas, in megawatts?
SELECT sum(try_cast(t_cap AS double)) / 1000 AS megawatts FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE t_state = 'KS'
From which foreign countries do the most U.S. trademark filings come?
SELECT own_addr_country_cd AS country, count(DISTINCT serial_no) AS filings FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_owner WHERE own_addr_country_cd NOT IN ('', 'US') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of single audit findings are material weaknesses?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN upper(substr(cast(is_material_weakness AS varchar), 1, 1)) = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_executive.fac_findings
Which kinds of toxicity prompt drug warnings most often?
SELECT warning_class, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_drug_warning WHERE warning_class IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many trademark filings claim a three-dimensional shape?
SELECT count(*) AS marks FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file WHERE cast(draw_3d_file_in AS varchar) = '1'
Which companies filed the most 8-K current reports in 2024?

SELECT c.name, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_sec.submissions_filings f JOIN govblock_sec.submissions_companies c ON c.cik = f.cik WHERE f.form = '8-K' AND substr(cast(f.filingdate AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many recall campaigns involved Toyota vehicles in 2010?
SELECT count(DISTINCT campno) AS campaigns FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_recalls WHERE maketxt = 'TOYOTA' AND substr(cast(rcdate AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2010'
How are hospitals enrolled in Medicare organised as legal entities?
SELECT organization_type_structure, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_hospital_enrollments WHERE organization_type_structure IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many drug products in ChEMBL carry a black box warning?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_products WHERE black_box_warning = 1
In which states do Republicans hold the most legislative seats?
SELECT upper(substr(state_file, 1, 2)) AS state, count(*) AS republican_members FROM govblock_geo.legislature_members WHERE party = 'R' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many toxic-release reporting facilities are in Harris County, Texas?
SELECT count(DISTINCT _2_trifd) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE _7_county = 'HARRIS' AND _8_st = 'TX'
In which technology sectors are women most often among a patent's inventors?

SELECT first_wipo_sector_title AS sector, round(100.0 * sum(try_cast(women_inventors AS double)) / sum(try_cast(inventors AS double)), 1) AS pct_women_inventors FROM govblock_patents.pv_annual WHERE cast(assignee_sequence AS varchar) = '0' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many operating power plants on the national map burn coal as their main fuel?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_power_plants WHERE status = 'OP' AND prim_fuel IN ('BIT', 'SUB', 'LIG')
Which counties in California have the highest median home values?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS median_value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 AS a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_5yr AS g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0500000US06%' AND a.variable = 'B25077_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many patents has the USPTO withdrawn after granting them?
SELECT count(*) AS withdrawn FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_patent WHERE cast(withdrawn AS varchar) IN ('1', 'true', 'True')
In which companies do doctors hold the most valuable ownership stakes?

SELECT applicable_manufacturer_or_applicable_gpo_making_payment_name, sum(try_cast(value_of_interest AS double)) AS value FROM govblock_health.op_ownership WHERE program_year = '2024' AND applicable_manufacturer_or_applicable_gpo_making_payment_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people living in Queens were born outside the United States?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0500000US36081' AND variable = 'B05002_E013'
